🤖 Crypto’s next billion users may not be human

AI agents are beginning to make autonomous payments for data, computing power, API access and other digital services.

Stablecoins have taken an early lead in this emerging machine-to-machine economy.

Coinbase reports that its x402 payment protocol has already processed:

• more than 165 million payments
• approximately $50 million in total value
• an average transaction of roughly $0.30

According to Coinbase’s head of AI product, an estimated 99% of these payments use USDC.

Why are stablecoins attracting this activity?

AI agents often need to make small, frequent payments across borders. Traditional card fees become inefficient when a service costs only a few cents.

Stablecoins can operate around the clock, settle digitally and interact directly with software.

But the market remains experimental.

Companies are still working on spending limits, approved sellers, escrow, refunds and determining responsibility when an agent makes the wrong purchase.

The next stage of crypto adoption may not begin with another trading app.

It may begin when software needs money of its own.

🌍 Iran’s Borujen  begins Government Week with the inauguration of 52 projects

📌 Shahr-e-Kord, IRNA – The governor of Borujen County in the southwestern Iranian Province of Chaharmahal and Bakhtiari has announced the inauguration and operation of 52 projects in the fields of infrastructure, tourism, education, industry, and agriculture, simultaneously with the beginning of the Government Week.

Masoud Zamani made the announcement at an inauguration ceremony for Borujen projects on Monday, held in the presence of the provincial governor’s deputy coordinator for economic affairs.
​
He said 5,790 billion rials were spent on the projects, financed by government credits, private-sector investments, and bank facilities, and that their implementation would improve services and strengthen Borujen’s economic capacity.
​
Overall, Chaharmahal and Bakhtiari Province is set to inaugurate or put into operation hundreds of projects during this year’s Government Week, including 787 projects related to construction alone, with a credit of 50 trillion rials.
​
The province has, so far, inaugurated and operated 3,315 projects during the administration of President Masoud Pezeshkian, which will increase to 4,130 with the addition of this year’s Government Week projects.
